draft_en.subject: Low-cost 10G/100G ToR for lab and research networks
draft_en.body:
Hi John,

I wrote on 19 October under "24 Port PoE Managed Switch"; this is a different angle, so a fresh note rather than a reply.

For the research and university accounts you serve, we supply Centec-based L3 ToR switches as a lower-cost tier next to the mainstream brands: STH-2C24XF-HSI, 24 x 10G SFP+ + 2 x 100G QSFP28, L3 (OSPF/BGP, VXLAN), dual hot-swap PSUs, 12-month warranty, USD 1,500 EXW Shenzhen (snapshot 2026-10-27, valid 15 days).

Is a price-first ToR option something your lab customers ask for, or do they stay with the incumbent brands regardless?

Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
